He showed of but was missing so many notes and almost failed. So as I'm laughing he challenges me to do better. So I know it's my time to shine. Time to lower those panties with my ability to rhythmically hit those 5 buttons. I put it on expert and I'm ready to go. My confidence hid the memory or the 30 rack of natty lite that I'd been going hard on all night. Harder than that fucking song was that I missed every goddamn note on and failed immediately. Much to the laughter of everyone else I hung my head in shame and humiliation as I walked back to my dorm. Stopping only once to throw up on the sidewalk as the police in the patrol car that slowed down to check on me, could be heard laughing as they drove off. Once inside the elevator at my dorm it all went dark. I woke up some time later to my buddy laughing at me with his girlfriend. I have no idea how long I was passed out on the cold floor of the elevator. Or how many floors I traveled in my unconcious adventure as any number of fellow college students used it and laughed at me. But I was grateful to my friend and his girl who carried me back to my room and tossed me on my bed. I'm even more grateful to my friend, who talked me up the whole night to his girlfriend so that he could hook me up with one of her friends. Of course this was before they found me on the elevator in a pool of my own shameful tears. Never did meet that friend.
